# Synthetic Polymarket public-market fixtures

These deterministic JSON messages are wholly synthetic adaptations of the
documented public market-channel schemas. They were not captured from a live
Polymarket endpoint and contain no account data, wallet identifiers, API
credentials, private keys, orders, or real market text.

The deliberately small sample contains one invented binary BTC market with two
invented outcome token IDs. Long decimal strings exercise exact-byte and
decimal-lexeme preservation; they are not observations or executable quotes.
